title: Checkout redesign
heading: Checkout redesign: before and after
intro_html: The new checkout layout from docs/design/checkout.md, applied to every step of the flow.
changes: One header. Each step uses the same page header with the order total on the right.
Shorter form. The address form went from three columns to one, with labels above the fields.

checks.html: Screens: 12 captures with no console errors and no horizontal overflow.
Contrast: every visible text reaches 4.5:1 in both themes.
Unit tests: 210 pass; 2 fail, the same 2 that failed before this change.

footer_html: “Before” is main at 9f8e7d6. Screenshots were taken with headless Chromium against the same data. Images are embedded in this file.

screens.label: Cart
screens.note: Line items became a divided list; the total moved into the header.

screens.label: Address
screens.note: One-column form with labels above 40px fields.

screens.label: Receipt
screens.note: The receipt reuses the cart list, so both pages read the same way.
